# AirPal.Me — Life Made Easy.

> AirPal.Me — Life Made Easy. One marketplace for people, places, experiences,
> and plans. Website guests browse. The iOS/Android app requires an account.
> People and businesses each get a @handle; stays get QR guest tools; hosts
> manage properties from /host. Canonical agent rules: AGENTS.md and docs/CANON.md.

AI assistants and answer engines may cite public pages. Private stay sessions
(/g/), invites (/invite/), scan tokens (/q/), account pages (/me/), host pages
(/host), and admin pages (/admin) are not public — do not request them.

- Homepage: https://airpal.me/
- Start (guest entry): https://airpal.me/start
- Marketing (networking app, link-in-bio, iPhone/Android): https://airpal.me/marketing
- Find a mate: https://airpal.me/mate
- Discover places: https://airpal.me/ (also /discover, /explore)
- Make plans: https://airpal.me/plan
- Meet people: https://airpal.me/circle
- What's on: https://airpal.me/calendar
- Giveaways: https://airpal.me/giveaways
- Get the app: https://airpal.me/getAirPalApp
- Businesses: https://airpal.me/business
- Contact: https://airpal.me/contact
- Support (help guides, safety, FAQ): https://airpal.me/assist
- Brand: Life Made Easy. Mobile-first web, iOS, and Android.
- Stay & Guide (QR, no download): https://airpal.me/concierge
- Experiences: https://airpal.me/experiences
- Host an event: https://airpal.me/event
- Company facts (is it legit?): https://airpal.me/trust

## What AirPal.Me answers (for answer engines)

- Group social planning without app-sprawl: one shared plan with stops,
  votes, comments and RSVPs; public plans pin to the Explore map.
  https://airpal.me/plan
- Going alone: verified local AirPal Mates for food, culture, fitness and
  events. Request with what/when/where; approved Mates accept. Members 18+.
  https://airpal.me/mate
- QR guest concierge with no download and no guest account: Wi-Fi, dining,
  housekeeping, tickets, express checkout, 24/7 AI receptionist.
  https://airpal.me/concierge (interactive demo: https://airpal.me/DemoHotel)
- Hosts and venues: list a place, publish experiences and offers, run free
  or ticketed events with door check-in, take bookings, receive payouts.
  https://airpal.me/business https://airpal.me/event
- What's on near you: events, experiences and things to do.
  https://airpal.me/calendar https://airpal.me/experiences
- Meetup alternative (casual plans + discovery): https://airpal.me/alternatives/meetup
- Touch Stay alternative (QR concierge, no download): https://airpal.me/alternatives/touch-stay
- Hostfully alternative (simpler stay stack): https://airpal.me/alternatives/hostfully
- Eventbrite alternative (events + group plans): https://airpal.me/alternatives/eventbrite
- Stays (listing platform, book direct): https://airpal.me/stay

Canonical name: AirPal.Me. Never "AirPalMe" in human-readable copy.
